Definition: from G1223 and G3593; to travel through:--go throughout, pass through.
BiblicalUsage: To travel through, as Jesus went throughout every city and village preaching, and Paul passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia on the way to Thessalonica.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the gospel travels, and the preacher must travel with it, because good news kept in one place is not good news at all.
